source_refs.note: Book p. 277: 14.3.4 Properties of Cross Product (i)-(v); property (ii) printed without its minus sign; proofs left to students.

blocks.text: Har nayi multiplication ki kuch khoobiyan (properties) hoti hain jo hisaab ko aasan banati hain. Is sabaq mein cross product ki paanch properties dekhenge. Kitab in ke saboot (proofs) students par chhorti hai; hum har ek ki chhoti si wajah aap ko samjha denge, taa ke aap inhein yaad bhi rakh sakein aur imtihan mein likh bhi sakein.
Cross product mein yeh properties hoti hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein property (ii) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) chhapi hai; minus ka nishan reh gaya hai. Sahi property \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = -(\underline{v} \times \underline{u})\) hai, jo humne 14.3.3 (c) mein saabit ki thi. Upar humne sahi likha hai.
Kitab kehti hai: in properties ke proofs students ke liye exercise ke taur par chhore gaye hain. Neeche har ek ki wajah di gayi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har property ki chhoti wajah (hamari taraf se):
(i) Agar ek vector \(\underline{0}\) ho to us ki lambai 0 hai, is liye \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta = 0\) ho jata hai. Zero lambai ka vector zero vector hai.
(ii) Lambai wahi rehti hai, lekin tarteeb ulatne se right hand rule direction ulti kar deta hai (14.3.3 (c)).
(iii) Cross product jama (addition) par aise hi phailta hai jaise aam zarb: \(2 \times (3 + 4) = 2 \times 3 + 2 \times 4\). Isay components se check kiya ja sakta hai (14.3.5). Yahi property 14.3.5 mein determinant formula banane mein kaam aayegi.
(iv) Yahan \(k\) scalar (sirf number) hai. Kisi vector ko \(k\) se zarb dein to us ki lambai \(|k|\) guna ho jati hai (aur \(k\) negative ho to direction ulat jati hai), is liye cross product bhi \(k\) guna ho jata hai. Scalar ko bahar nikaal sakte hain.
(v) \(\underline{u}\) aur khud \(\underline{u}\) ke darmiyan angle 0 hai, aur \(\sin 0 = 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ek property jo cross product mein NAHIN hai: associative (brackets idhar udhar karna). Misaal dekhiye:
\[(\underline{i} \times \underline{i}) \times \underline{j} = \underline{0} \times \underline{j} = \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{i} \times (\underline{i} \times \underline{j}) = \underline{i} \times \underline{k} = -\underline{j}\]
Kyun: pehli line mein pehle \(\underline{i} \times \underline{i} = \underline{0}\) bana, phir zero vector ka har cross product zero. Doosri line mein pehle \(\underline{i} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\) bana, phir \(\underline{i} \times \underline{k} = -\underline{j}\). Dono jawab alag! Is liye brackets kabhi apni marzi se mat hilaiye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari misaal, kitab ka sawal nahin.) Property (iv) aur (ii) istemal kar ke \((3\underline{i}) \times (4\underline{j})\) aur \((4\underline{j}) \times (3\underline{i})\) nikaliye.
\((3\underline{i}) \times (4\underline{j}) = 3 \cdot 4\,(\underline{i} \times \underline{j}) = 12\underline{k}\).
\((4\underline{j}) \times (3\underline{i}) = 12\,(\underline{j} \times \underline{i}) = -12\underline{k}\).
Kyun: scalars (3 aur 4) bahar aa gaye, aur tarteeb ulatne se sirf sign badla. Dono jawab ek doosre ke ulte hain, bilkul property (ii) ke mutabiq.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya \(\underline{u} \times (-\underline{v})\) aur \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) barabar hain? (Jawab: haan. Property (iv) se \(\underline{u} \times (-\underline{v}) = -(\underline{u} \times \underline{v})\), aur property (ii) se yeh \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) hai.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = -(\underline{v} \times \underline{u})\): commutative nahin.
2. Distributive: \(\underline{u} \times (\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = \underline{u} \times \underline{v} + \underline{u} \times \underline{w}\).
3. Scalar bahar aata hai: \(\underline{u} \times (k\underline{v}) = k(\underline{u} \times \underline{v})\).
4. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u} = \underline{0}\) aur \(\underline{u} \times \underline{0} = \underline{0}\).
5. Associative nahin: brackets mat hilaiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Property (ii) ko kitab ki tarah minus ke baghair likh dena. Imtihan mein yeh ghalti poore number kaat sakti hai.
2. Brackets hilana: \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \times \underline{w}\) aam taur par \(\underline{u} \times (\underline{v} \times \underline{w})\) ke barabar nahin hota.
3. Property (iii) se kholte waqt vectors ki tarteeb badal dena: har product mein jo vector pehle tha, woh pehle hi rahe.
